Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long straight copper red hair — full body mirror-polished liquid chrome fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is a seamless liquid-metal chrome shell curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, every curve of her torso, hips and legs one continuous perfect mirror surface reflecting the surrounding mirror room in sharp warped images that bend over each curve, hard bright white highlights and deep dark reflections side by side. BLAZING flawless mirror-silver chrome across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale pink and warm white reflections warping over every curve, completely opaque, mirror-polished with a deep three-dimensional liquid-metal surface. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the mirror chrome body is one unbroken flawless mirror shell, her bust gleaming whole and seamless, her arms and legs too, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved mirror chrome right down to the shoes.

Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved mirror chrome.

Background: a hexagonal room with floor-to-ceiling mirrors on all six walls and a white mirrored floor, soft white light from above, so that her figure repeats in a ring of identical reflections that recede in six directions like a kaleidoscope, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright soft white light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
